description: This file defines the class MapBasedExecutionContext which implements the ExecutionContext interface, providing a map-based storage for context properties and a tracing context for distributed tracing. It includes methods for creating empty or initialized contexts, retrieving and setting properties, and accessing the tracing context.

classes.name: MapBasedExecutionContext
classes.description: A map-backed implementation of the ExecutionContext interface, allowing storage and retrieval of properties and tracing span context.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates and returns a new, empty execution context.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new execution context initialized with the provided properties.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a property by key, returning null if not found.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a property by key, returning the provided default value if not found.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a property in the context with the given key.

methods.name: getTracingContext
methods.description: Returns the current SpanContext used for distributed tracing.

methods.name: setTracingContext
methods.description: Sets the SpanContext for tracing purposes.

methods.name: asMap
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable view of the internal properties map.
